description: Makes 3–4 genuinely different art directions of the same brief side by side in one new design — e.g. Swiss minimal, Y2K chrome, risograph print, editorial serif (also: brutalist, soft sun, terminal glow, flag wave) — each its own composition, palette and type pairing, not one layout recoloured. Show them to the person and ask which one wins; then call keep_direction. Counts as one design.

brief.description: what it is for, in the person’s words; e.g. «poster for a jazz night at our bar»

directions.description: directions the person asked for; the rest are picked to differ most

eyebrow.description: the small line near the headline (a date, a tag)

headline.description: the big line, 2–6 words (\n for a line break)

name.description: the file’s name; e.g. «Jazz night: directions»

photo.description: words for one photo shared by the directions (optional)

title: Style battle
